Data Engineer (Mid-level), Hybrid - Berlin

We are looking for a Data Engineer to build and maintain our data platform.

Requirements:
- 3+ years of experience as a data engineer
- Strong Python and SQL
- Experience with Airflow and dbt
- Familiarity with AWS (S3, Redshift)

Nice to have:
- Kafka
- Terraform

You will be our go-to person for data engineering, DevOps, frontend dashboards and customer support.

Hybrid: 3 days per week in our Berlin office.
Salary: EUR 65,000 - 80,000 per year.
